characterInteraction.description: The entire scene is a monologue by Syed Muhammad Baqer Qazwini.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene highlights the importance of faith and the eventual triumph of good over evil. The joining of Muslims and Christians signifies unity and peace under the rule of a just leader.

narrativeProgression.description: A statement about a grand call in the heavens announcing the reappearance of the Mahdi.
People are instructed to go forward three months to the night of Ashura, where the Imam will be waiting for his 313 companions.
All the 313 companions gather in Masjid al-Haram, and Allah shows them how to get there.
Sufyani and evil powers are looking for the Mahdi, who has prayed Maghrib and Isha with the 313 companions.
The Imam gives a speech with his back to the Kaaba, facing the crowd. The speech is documented in books.
The Imam reminds the world of the oppression faced by his grandfather, Imam al-Hussein.
The Imam's movement begins, and the Sufyani hears that the Mahdi has emerged from Mecca.
The Sufyani sends an army of 70,000 men to fight the Mahdi. They travel south from the Syrian region to Medina.
The Sufyani's army desecrates Medina and is told to go to Mecca and assassinate the Mahdi.
The 70,000 strong army leaves Medina and reaches an area called Baida.
The Prophet Muhammad cried upon seeing Baida, predicting that an army would try to kill the Mahdi there, but Allah will destroy them.
Allah sends Jibraeel to destroy the army by splitting the ground open and swallowing them.
The Imam waits the following day for 10,000 supporters.
The 10,000 supporters join the Imam, and he leaves Mecca, heading north. 50 of the 313 companions are women.
The Imam's movement continues north, and the armies of Yamani and Khorasani join him. He goes to Karbala and shows the oppression that happened to Imam al-Hussein.
The Imam goes north to Kufa and establishes his government there.
The Imam is given instructions by Allah to go to Palestine. He departs with his companions and heads towards Palestine. The Sufyani tries to stop him but fails.
The non-Muslim world is observing the events, and some Muslims, like the Sufyani and other terrorists, try to stop the Imam.
When the Imam liberates Palestine, non-Muslim powers mobilize to fight the Mahdi.

Right before the war starts, Jesus descends from the heavens with 800 supporters. The Christians are initially confused but observe the situation, thinking Jesus will side with them to kill the Mahdi.
Jesus walks to the Imam and asks him to lead the prayer out of humbleness. The Mahdi stands, and Jesus prays behind him. When the Christian world sees this, they join forces to support the Imam.

trimmingSuggestions.description: Shortening the initial setup: The information about the call in the heavens and the gathering of the 313 companions could be condensed.
Cutting down on repetitive descriptions: The descriptions of Sufyani's army movements and their eventual demise could be made more concise.
Eliminating the tangent about the Imam's visit to Karbala: While emotionally significant, this brief segment distracts from the main narrative flow.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hadith states on the 23rd of the month of Ramadan, there will be a grand call in the heavens.
Jibra'in will make that announcement that the Mehdi has now reappeared or is about to reappear.
People are getting ready. Go three months forward on the night of Ashura.
In Masjid Al-Haram, the Imam Ali Salam is waiting for the 313 companions together.
All the 313 from around the world, they gather in Masjid Al-Haram.
Allah takes them there. He shows them how to get there on Leyla, Ashura.
Now, Jaysus, Safiani, the Safiani and the evil powers they're looking for the Mehdi,
they're waiting for him. Any minute he's going to leave, you know, come out,
because Jibra'in made that call. The Imam is in Mecca. He prays,
Maghrib and Ashat, Jama'a, with the 313. Then,
Imam Al-Bakr Ali Salam tells us this, then he puts his back towards the Kaaba to face the crowd
and he gives a speech. Even the text of the speech, brothers and sisters, has been documented
in our books. Ali Ma'am Al-Bakr says, what the Mehdi will say? What he will say to the world?
Read his speeches, they're beautiful. They give you hope, they give you faith.
And then towards the end of his speech, the Imam Ali Salam, he reminds the world of
his grandfather, Abu Abdullah Al-Haseen,
Al-A'ya, Ahl Al-Alam, Anassam, Samul, Muntakim, Al-A'ya, Ahl Al-Alam,
Inna Jaddiy al-Haseen, O Tala'at-Shayana. He says this to the world.
So the 313 are now surrounding the Imam, his movement begins. Who hears Safiani?
Safiani hears that the Mehdi has now emerged from Mecca. Safiani sends an army of 70,000 people
and army of 70,000 strong men to go and fight the Mehdi. They come from the Syrian region,
they go south to Medina. So they hear the Mehdi has appeared where Mecca. Mecca is where to Medina,
it's to the south of Medina. So the Safiani sends his powerful army and he tells them,
go to Mecca and assassinate the Mehdi. That 70,000 strong army leaves Medina. By the way,
you know what they do in Medina, they desecrate the city. There will be some challenging days.
The Hadith states anyone whose name is Ali Fatima Hassan Hussein will be massacred by the army of
Safiani. Allahu Akbar. They're going south to Mecca, they reach an area called Beidah.
It's not too far from Medina. One day Rasulullah, Allahu Ali,hu a'lehi, was standing on Beidah,
the land of Beidah. He looked at the land and he cried. He told his companions, my companions,
one day an army here in Beidah will try to go and kill the Mehdi when Allah's Panwata'ala will
destroy them. How does Allah destroy them? Allah sends Jibra'id to that land called Beidah. You have
70,000 of the army of Safiani. With his wings, Jibra'il, with his wings, he splits the ground
open. The ground swallows the 70,000. Al-Khastfu Bil Beidah. That is one of the signs of the
reappearance of Ali Mahmadi. And it is a definite sign from the Al-Alamat Al-Hattamiya.
So Allah's Panwata'ala gets rid of that army. So Ali Mahmadi, Abdullah, Allahu Akbar,
Allahu Akbar, Allah Allah. He waits the following day, which is now the day of Ashura. He waits for 10,000
supporters. That is the next inner circle of the Imam. The very close ones are 313 and 50 of the
313 are women by the way. 50 of them are women. The Imam waits for his next second circle of
supporters, which are 10,000. Once they join, these people are very faithful but not as high as the
313. They come, they join the Imam, the Imam leaves Mecca. He goes north. Now the army of
Safiani is no longer in his way. So the Imam Ali's Imam goes north and then he makes a north
turn towards Iraq. On his way to Iraq, the armies of Yemeni and Khurasani join the Imam,
Abdullah, Allahu Akbar. They come, they pledge allegiance. The Imam first goes to Karbala,
something emotional happens in Karbala, not to mention it now. He goes to the grave of Ali
Mahmadi Hussain Ali's Salah. And he showed some of the oppression that happened to Ali Mahmadi Hussain.
Then he goes north to Khufa because the headquarters, the capital of the government of Ali Mahmadi
isn't Khufa. That's the capital of the government of Imam Ali Ali's Salah also. So he goes to Khufa,
he establishes his government there. Then the Imam, Abdullah Uta'ala Farajah, is given instructions
by Allahu Akbar Uta'ala to go to Palestine. So the Imam departs with his companions and they go
towards Palestine. On his way, as Safiani tries to stop the Imam, he fails to stop the Imam.
Allah grants a victory. He goes to Palestine and the Imam liberates Palestine from occupying forces.
We don't exactly know who they are. The Hadith does not specify who they are, but it says
occupying forces in Palestine. The Imam will liberate Palestine from them. Now up until this point,
the non-Muslim world is just watching. They don't get involved yet. Yes, some Muslims like the
Sufianian others, so-called Muslims, terrorists, they try to stop the Imam. But the Christian world,
the non-Muslim world is just observing here. They're like, you know, this is a Muslim thing. Let's not
get involved. When Imam Al-Mahdi'a Abdullah Uta'ala Farajah liberates Palestine, now the lobbies start
mobilizing Western powers or non-Muslim powers and they come to fight the Mehdi. They mobilize
their armies. They come to Palestine. They want to fight the Mehdi now. Imagine this scene. The
whole world is watching. Massive armies are just about to fight the Imam. Abdullah Uta'ala Farajah
in Palestine. Right before the war starts, something miraculous happens. What happens suddenly,
A. Subnimariam descends from the heavens with 800 supporters, 800 of his companions. He descends
from the heavens and he comes down. Now initially it seems the Christians are confused on whose side is he?
Maybe now he came so we can get rid of this Mehdi. Some of them do think that even until today
listen to some of their priests, they talk about the Mehdi being the Antichrist. Yes, I've seen a
speech by a very influential reverent who says this Mehdi is the Antichrist, whom Jesus will
kill. So they have this idea. So Isa Ali Selam comes. The world is now anxious. What's going to
happen? So the Christians think he's going to side with them to kill the Mehdi. They're observing.
Isa Ali Selam walks to the Imam of Mehdi. Abdullah Uta'ala Farajah. It's the time of Salana
in Jerusalem, in Palestine, in Batal Makdus. What happens? Ali Imam of Mehdi, Abdullah Uta'ala
Farajah. Tazam Yarruh Allah. Out of humbleness. He doesn't lead the prayer.
Isa Ali Selam puts his hand on the shoulder of the Mehdi and he says you have a greater right to
it. Yabna Rasulullah. You lead the prayer. Al-Mahdi stands, Allah Akbar. Isa Bin Imeriyam stands
before him and he prays behind him. When the Christian world sees Jesus praying behind the
Mehdi, they all join forces to support Imam Mehdi. Abdullah Uta'ala Farajah.
